cost_basis: local CPU ONNX inference; no metered API is called, so the cost of a re-embed is wall-clock time and nothing is billed. No monetary figure is published because none was measured.
probe: the sampled chunks' text was modified, re-embedded through the production loader, measured, and rolled back; the corpus is unchanged
staleness_definition: seconds between a chunk's new text being handed to the loader (content_changed_at) and its replacement vector existing (embedded_at), worst case over the changed chunks
